common.app_tagline: Brand coverage, visibility and citation in neural-network answers.

overview_coverage.label: Answer coverage
overview_coverage.hint: Share of queries where the engine rendered a grounded, source-backed answer — an AI Overview on Google, a web-search-backed answer on chat engines. This is the denominator for all visibility: you can only show up where a grounded answer appeared at all. Formula: grounded answers ÷ all queries.

visibility_in_sources.label: Visibility in sources
visibility_in_sources.hint: Of queries with a grounded answer — the share where your domain made it into the answer's source list (at any position). Formula: queries with the domain in sources ÷ queries with a grounded answer.

visibility_in_citations.label: Visibility in citations
visibility_in_citations.hint: Of queries with a grounded answer — the share where your domain is cited in the answer text (an inline link in the prose). Citations are a subset of sources: the model cites what it retrieved, so a cited domain is always a source too. Formula: queries with a citation ÷ queries with a grounded answer.

avg_source_position.label: Avg. source position
avg_source_position.hint: Average best (minimum) position of your domain in the answer's source list — averaged over the queries where it is present. Lower is better.

avg_citation_position.label: Avg. citation position
avg_citation_position.hint: Average best position of your link among the citations in the answer text — averaged over the queries where it is present. Lower is better.

relative_citation.label: Source→citation conversion
relative_citation.hint: Of the queries where your domain made it into sources, the share where the model actually cited you. Formula: n_cited ÷ n_in_sources. Higher is better.

brand_mention_rate.label: Brand mention rate
brand_mention_rate.hint: Of queries with a grounded answer — the share where the answer text mentions the brand NAME, linked or not. An unlinked mention is invisible to the link funnel, so this is a separate axis: mentioned does not imply cited, and cited does not imply mentioned. Formula: answers mentioning the brand ÷ grounded answers.

dashboard.run_context_group: Repeat group ×{n} · latest run #{id} · {datetime} · values are the group mean, chips show min–max spread
dashboard.spread_title: Min–max spread across {n} repeats — a stability signal, not precision
dashboard.run_context_empty: No data for the selected brand / engine.
dashboard.chart_info: Metric values across completed runs over time, for the selected lens. Percentages on the left axis, average positions on the right (lower is better).
dashboard.chart_empty: No completed runs to plot a trend.
dashboard.lens_panel_info: Metrics by query type (general / branded / comparative) plus the aggregate “All lenses” row.
dashboard.lens_empty: No metrics for the selected run.
dashboard.sentiment_panel_info: A short qualitative summary of how AI answers treat the brand, per query type — synthesized from the per-query sentiments.
dashboard.competitors_panel_info: Every domain that appears in the AI answers for the selected scope — brand competitors and publishers alike — ranked by how often it shows up, with its average position. Your brand is highlighted. Share = appearances ÷ queries with a grounded answer. Click a column header to re-sort.
dashboard.competitors_empty: No domain data for the selected run.
dashboard.matrix_panel_info: The same brand across every captured engine, one row per engine. Numbers are shown side by side and never blended into one cross-engine score: each engine has its own grounded-answer semantics, so a blended average would be dishonest. Click an engine to open its full view.
dashboard.matrix_empty: No engines with runs for this brand.
dashboard.results_empty: No result rows for the selected run / lens.
dashboard.results_mention_yes: Brand mentioned in the answer text
dashboard.results_mention_no: Brand not mentioned in the answer text
dashboard.report_not_ready: The report.generate module is not ready yet. Run the command manually once it is available.
dashboard.audit_panel_info: A pre-run technical audit of the target domain — whether AI engines can read it (hard blockers) and whether it is optimized to be cited (advisory). Runs before capture; blockers can hard-stop a run.
dashboard.audit_empty: No audit for this domain yet.

report.engines_caption: Each engine keeps its own grounded-answer gate; numbers are shown side by side and never blended into one cross-engine score.
report.competitors_intro: Every domain that shares the AI answer space for these queries — brand competitors and publishers alike — by how often it appears and its average position. Your brand's row is highlighted.
report.competitors_caption: Share = queries where the domain is in sources ÷ queries with a grounded answer. Average positions in ranks (lower is better). Your brand's row is marked “(you)”.
report.competitors_empty: No domain data for this run.
report.kpi_no_prev: Current run: {current}   ·   no previous run — deltas not computed
report.lenses_caption: Visibility in % (of queries with a grounded answer); average positions in ranks (lower is better). The “All queries” row is the cross-lens total.
report.funnel_intro: The brand's path inside AI answers, narrowing at each step: where a grounded answer is shown → where the brand made it into sources → where it is cited (citations are a subset of sources — the last step is the source→citation conversion).
report.funnel_rates: Of queries with a grounded answer: in sources {sources}    •    in citations {citations}
report.funnel_empty: No data to build the funnel.
report.history_intro: Change in key metrics (the “All queries” lens) across completed runs.
report.sentiment_intro: Representative phrasings from AI answers about the brand — no numeric score, as-is.
report.sentiment_empty: No qualitative sentiment marks in this run.
report.audit_intro: A pre-run technical audit of the target domain: category-A checks are hard blockers (can an AI engine read you at all); the rest are advisory. Blockers can stop a run before capture.
report.audit_empty: No audit recorded for this domain.
report.audit_caption: Category A = crawl-access blockers; B/C/D = advisory. Check titles are engine-neutral; the remediation snippets live in the audit JSON.
